notes.title: OSES - Twin-stick Update!
notes.content:
A big update for OSES was just released! Here's what's new

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30594970/3bc71ec9bfc702ff53e04769e62554813dc44c49.png[/img]
[list][*][b]Controls revamp:[/b] New control modes allow for better and easier gameplay.
[list][*]Shoot in all directions using the [b]Twin-stick[/b] mode!
[*]Move and aim smoothly with the [b]Behind[/b] option!
[*]Play the classic way with [b]8 directions![/b]
[/list]

[*][b]Weapons balance[/b]
[list][*][b]Pistol and Assault rifle[/b] ammo capacity reduced!
[*][b]Laser gun[/b] has now an overheat mechanic, it will now requirea reload if you let its ammo count get to zero!
[/list]

[*]New camera option allows you to configure the height of the camera.
[*][b]4 new challenging maps[/b], one for each gamemode.
[*]Some maps now have the sleeping zombies mechanic.
[*]Drone is now only available in generator defense
[*]Weapon drops are now more predictable.
[*]Multiple new sound effects.
[*]3 new songs! 1 of them being exclusive to stealth gameplay
[*]Better menu flow.
[*]Added new options that allow for customization of the UI.
[*]Fixed some issues with the Leaderboards.
[*]Fixed minor bugs
[/list]

Have fun playing the update and please report any bug you find!

notes.title: End of the year Update!
notes.content:
Hello Survivors!

The game just had a quick small update! Here's the changes!
[list]
[*]Added [b]4 new Campaign maps![/b]
[*]Added new commands with focus on narrative building.
[*]Bug fixes
[/list]
That's it for this year! Thank you for all players and i wish everyone a happy new year!

notes.title: December Update!!
notes.content:
Hey there!
The winter sale is here and with it, one of OSES's biggest updates so far!

Here's what has changed:
[list]
[*]Lots of [b]textures[/b] remade from scratch! They're beautiful, clearer and better in every way!
[*]New drone mechanic: call different airdrops to help on the fight
[*][b]MUSIC!![/b] 7 amazing tracks by Gabriel Oliveira added to the game!
[*][b]All Challenge maps[/b] redesigned for a better experience
[*]Console added, bringing great improvemets for mapping and for playing around!
[*]Map editor triggers changed to Console triggers, with more flexibility
[*]Lots of bug fixes!
[/list]

And that's it for this update, there'll be some more tweaks in the following days! But for now, have a look at this beautiful screenshot of the update! See you next time!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30594970/fd86aa301ad189ae3fd2e8bee89a58c1bda9ebb5.png[/img]

notes.title: OSES Halloween update!
notes.content:
The halloween update has come to OSES, and it brings a lot of new stuff! Check out what's changed below:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30594970/123d0882f56328610e5eaa8129271c1a860ba7c5.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]New game mode[/b]: BOSS BATTLE. Defeat the boss while managing your ammunition and collecting new weapons around the map.
[*]3 new Halloween themed [b]hats[/b].
[*]New models for health, ammo and food boxes.
[*]5 new [b]level editor items[/b]: halloween tree, coffin, grave, boss spawn and weapon drop.
[*]Gates, bridges and elevators will now flash when activated for better visibility.
[*]New BOSS BATTLE main map.
[*]CAMPAIGN MODE: 3 sequential maps that tell a short story.
[*]Controller main menu navigation.
[*]Zombie spawn rate balanced for Escape and Boss battle game modes.
[*]Friendly bots now have better aim and only shoot when looking at the target.
[*]General weapon balance.
[*]Important [b]Leaderboard[/b] fixes.
[*]Bigger shop icons.
[*]"Next level" option when a main or campaign map is completed.
[/list]

notes.title: Update! 10/07
notes.content:
OSES was just updated! Here's what's new:
[list]
    [*]Cloud saves: save games are shared between computers
    [*]New UI for characters and generator lifebars.
[/list]
Have fun playing these updates, remember to let me know if you find any bugs in the game. We'll have a Halloween update coming later this month, so stay tuned for that! Bye!
